thread:
marta: Observed a small but growing 400 spike during the v2 traffic shift. Looks like some 1.0 clients are sending `X-API-Version: 2` and our gateway is rejecting them.

leo: Do we have sample request/headers?

marta: Pasted sample from proxy logs:
```
{"ts":"2026-03-20T22:12:10Z","tenant":"partner-beta","path":"/api/generate","headers":{"X-API-Version":"2","User-Agent":"partner-sdk/1.0.0"},"resp_status":400}
```

deploy-bot: Alert created: `route-6123456789-gateway-400s` scope=us-east metric=400_rate value=1.2% threshold=0.5% window=5m

sasha: That matches the SDK bug we saw in the 1.0 branch where header normalization was added client-side. Partners on 1.0 may be auto-sending v2 header. Suggest immediate mitigation: pin affected tenants + pause further shifts.

dmitri: Agreed. Mitigation plan: 1) pause the shift job, 2) pin impacted tenants (partner-beta, partner-gamma), 3) shift 30% traffic back to v1 to reduce error surface, 4) notify CS and integrators. Rollback criteria: if 400_rate > 1% sustained 3m OR p95 latency in downstream proxy > 200ms.

leo: I'll open a tiny release-note addendum and a tenant mail template. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/release-notes/pull/399 (WIP)

marta: Applying pins now. Commands:
`/deploybot pin add partner-beta partner-gamma`
`/deploybot shift update shift-job-6123456789 --target v2=30`


deploy-bot: Executing: pin add partner-beta partner-gamma -> OK
deploy-bot: shift update accepted: target v2=30% (applied)

sasha: After pins + shift-back, watch for any 5xxs or auth errors. We might need a gateway shim to coerce header for 1.0 SDKs, but that's a patch for next week.

dmitri: CS notify once pins are applied. Leo, draft subject: "Temporary pause in v2 rollout for some legacy SDKs". Include steps for partners: upgrade SDK or set header to `1`.

leo: Draft ready, posting to #customer-success and will ping partner POCs.

deploy-bot: Snapshot at 6123456879: v2 traffic 30%, pins=[partner-beta,partner-gamma], paused_shift=true, alerts_active=route-6123456789-gateway-400s (reduced to 0.4% in last 3m).

marta: Looks stable for now. We'll keep roll paused and schedule a focused fix: gateway header-coerce fallback + notify partners. Plan a postmortem tomorrow morning and include SDK owners.

dmitri: Good. Tagging @oncall if we get re-escalation. Closing thread for ops handoff; keep updates here if anything changes.
